title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper XaaS Containers: Performance-Portable Representation With Source and IR Containers
problem: Artifact reproducibility verification for SC25 paper on performance-portable container representation
motivation: Reproducibility initiative ensures scientific findings can be independently verified and artifacts are usable by community
method: The evaluation independently runs the experiments and code from the XaaS Containers paper following the SC25 Reproducibility Committee's standardized guidelines, without access to the authors' original setup. Evaluators recreate the published results to verify whether other researchers can obtain the same outcomes. If successful, this confirms that the paper's experimental claims are reproducible and its conclusions are based on sound, repeatable evidence.
key_novelty: This is a reproducibility verification confirming that the XaaS Containers paper's experimental results can be independently reproduced, not a new technical method.
contributions: Independent verification of XaaS Containers implementation
limitations: Reproducibility report only; refer to original paper for technical details
